_readme: Single source for the tool overview (tools/index.html) and the 'More free tools' block on every tool page. Edit here, then run: node scripts/build-tools.mjs  (check: node --test). Only tools with status 'live' are linked.

tools.name: Subtitle Converter
tools.desc: Convert SRT to VTT, VTT to SRT, ASS or TXT and shift timing – a free subtitle converter online that runs in your browser, no upload.
tools.tagline: SRT, VTT, ASS and TXT – convert and shift timing.
tools.icon: <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M7 15h4M13 15h4M7 11h10"/>

tools.name: TikTok / Reels / Shorts Safe Zone Checker
tools.desc: Free TikTok safe zone checker and overlay templates: drop your image or video and see what the app UI will cover. No upload.
tools.tagline: See what TikTok, Reels and Shorts buttons cover.
tools.icon: <rect x="6" y="2" width="12" height="20" rx="2.5"/><path d="M9 6h6M9 18h3"/>

tools.name: HIIT & Tabata Timer
tools.desc: Free HIIT timer online with sound: Tabata, EMOM, 45/15, 30/30 and boxing rounds – beeps, voice, screen stays awake.
tools.tagline: Tabata, EMOM and custom rounds with beeps and voice.

tools.name: Workout Plan Generator
tools.desc: Free workout plan generator: pick your goal, 2–6 days a week and your equipment and get a 4-week training plan with sets, reps, rest and progression. No sign-up.
tools.tagline: 4-week training plan for gym, dumbbells or bodyweight.

tools.name: Brown & White Noise Machine
tools.desc: Brown noise generator and white noise machine online: brown, pink, white noise, rain, fan, ocean – sleep timer, black screen, no ads.
tools.tagline: Brown, pink and white noise with a sleep timer.

tools.name: Slowed + Reverb Maker
tools.desc: Slowed and reverb generator online: slow down your own song, add reverb and bass, hear it live, download a WAV. Nightcore maker too. No upload.
tools.tagline: Slow down a song, add reverb, download a WAV.
